description: Vista Ridge Mall is a regional shopping destination located at 2401 South Stemmons Freeway in Lewisville, Texas, serving the northern Dallas-Fort Worth metroplex. The mall has established itself as a convenient shopping hub for residents of Lewisville and surrounding communities including Flower Mound, Highland Village, and The Colony. While the website data does not provide extensive details about current tenants and amenities, Vista Ridge Mall's position along the Stemmons Freeway corridor provides excellent accessibility for shoppers throughout the region. Vista Ridge Mall continues to serve the growing northern suburbs of the Dallas-Fort Worth area with retail, dining, and entertainment options for local families and visitors.
